long_biography.plain_text:
A chance tennis match in Indianapolis introduced future Curtis Group founder Zbigniew Niemczycki to industrialist Beurt SerVaas. He had been driving friends to jobs at SerVaas's home when a tennis partner failed to arrive. The acquaintance became a working relationship, and Niemczycki earned progressively larger equity stakes through his contribution to the business.

For the Polish market, he initially imported televisions before setting up production in Mława in 1991. A separate plastics factory followed in nearby Krzywonoś. Cooperation with GoldStar developed into manufacturing for LG, which bought the Mława television factory in 1999.
